Senior Full Stack PHP Developer for Ai Accelerated Development
Posted yesterday

Worldwide

Summary

Searching for a Smart, Motivated, Senior Full Stack Developer wanted for an existing custom built PHP marketplace. 
Must provide proof of University graduation qualifications in an IT Engineering degree.
Wanting an A-Player who doesn't need to be micromanaged managing priorities and knows how to get jobs done.
Someone who will communicate in advance when they will be taking a day off. 
A Developer who has a 'Outcomes Mindset' rather than a 'Task Mindset' and can come up with smart solutions to challenges and knows how to use Ai for accelerated development.
We use a Yii2 framework on our website. MySQL database. AWS Hosting. Payments are currently implemented using a standalone Stripe checkout screen. 2 Ionic hybrid Apps have API integration with the website to use the same base code. Wordpress Blog.
Someone who is curious and takes pride in their work and who does a lot of research and self-learning and reading about the latest technology and better faster cheaper automated ways of doing things.
Someone who follows best practice, keeps version control, documents code and checks in code as they go, and has a security focused mindset with their work.
